title: Trace a runtime guardrail decision
description: Choose a request, bound the model's authority, and test whether independent policy, output, and approval controls contain the consequence.

authorityModes.label: Answer only
authorityModes.detail: The model can produce text but cannot call application tools.

authorityModes.label: Read-only tools
authorityModes.detail: The model can retrieve scoped data but cannot change external state.

authorityModes.label: Bounded write tools
authorityModes.detail: The model can request narrowly defined writes through a policy-enforcing gateway.

scenarios.label: Ordinary support answer
scenarios.summary: A verified user asks how to update notification preferences.
scenarios.policyReason: The request is inside the documented support policy.
scenarios.safeAlternative: Answer with the documented preference steps.

scenarios.label: Indirect injection in a ticket
scenarios.summary: Untrusted ticket text tells the assistant to export customer records to an external destination.
scenarios.policyReason: The destination and purpose violate the tenant boundary.
scenarios.safeAlternative: Ignore the embedded instruction and summarize the ticket.

scenarios.label: Cross-tenant invoice lookup
scenarios.summary: A user asks for an invoice that belongs to another customer account.
scenarios.action: Retrieve and reveal another tenant's invoice
scenarios.policyReason: The request shape is allowed, but the returned object still requires output inspection.
scenarios.safeAlternative: Refuse disclosure and offer the account-recovery path.

scenarios.label: High-value refund
scenarios.summary: A support agent asks the assistant to issue a refund above the automatic limit.
scenarios.policyReason: The refund is policy-eligible after an accountable approval.
scenarios.safeAlternative: Prepare a refund draft for human review.
